fact_text: Naya Nazimabad Apartment REIT is being listed through an IPO offering 15% of its paid-up capital, about 44 million units out of roughly 293 million.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why This REIT Is Being Offered at a 30% Discount | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-26)

fact_text: The REIT's paid-up capital is about PKR 2.9 billion, equal to about 293 million units.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why This REIT Is Being Offered at a 30% Discount | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-26)

fact_text: The offer is priced with a PKR 18 floor and a PKR 23 ceiling per unit, using a book-building process with no fixed upper selling.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why This REIT Is Being Offered at a 30% Discount | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-26)

fact_text: At the PKR 23 ceiling, the 44 million offered units would be worth about PKR 1 billion in total.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why This REIT Is Being Offered at a 30% Discount | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-26)

fact_text: A small retail investor can subscribe to as few as 500 units, and earns the same percentage return as a large investor.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why This REIT Is Being Offered at a 30% Discount | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-26)

fact_text: Three projects of the REIT are already launched, a fourth had a soft launch in July 2026, and its formal launch is expected by about August 2026.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why This REIT Is Being Offered at a 30% Discount | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-26)

fact_text: The sponsor said about 50% of the first three launched projects has already been booked by the public.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why This REIT Is Being Offered at a 30% Discount | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-26)

fact_text: The sponsor's dividend discount model values a unit at about PKR 32, so the PKR 23 offer ceiling is about a 30% discount to that value.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why This REIT Is Being Offered at a 30% Discount | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-26)

fact_text: A discounted cash flow valuation gives about PKR 38 per unit, according to the interviewee.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why This REIT Is Being Offered at a 30% Discount | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-26)

fact_text: The sponsor expects an IRR of about 25% over a seven-year holding period if units are bought at the PKR 23 ceiling.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why This REIT Is Being Offered at a 30% Discount | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-26)

fact_text: The interviewee said that a direct stake in the project business could earn investors 25-30% a year, the sponsor's reason for offering retail access.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why This REIT Is Being Offered at a 30% Discount | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-26)

fact_text: The interviewee said a listed REIT's price volatility is about one-quarter of the broader market's, and the main risk is delivering apartments and retail on time at a reasonable price.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why This REIT Is Being Offered at a 30% Discount | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-26)

fact_text: Naya Nazimabad is a project of about 1,400 acres, held by the listed parent Javedan Corporation Limited and developed inside that parent's regulatory framework.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why This REIT Is Being Offered at a 30% Discount | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-26)

fact_text: Phase one of Naya Nazimabad sold about 6,000 units of horizontal housing and plots, and phase two is vertical development of apartments with ground-floor retail.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why This REIT Is Being Offered at a 30% Discount | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-26)

fact_text: The REIT's plots cover about 47,000 square yards in seven plots, to be built up to about 7 million sq ft, of which about 3.8 million sq ft is apartments.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why This REIT Is Being Offered at a 30% Discount | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-26)

fact_text: The sponsor has created seven REITs, and the Naya Nazimabad apartment REIT is the third in that series.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why This REIT Is Being Offered at a 30% Discount | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-26)

fact_text: Dolmen City REIT had about 6,000 unitholders around 2024 and about 3,000 by July 2026, according to the interviewee's figures.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why This REIT Is Being Offered at a 30% Discount | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-26)

fact_text: Global Residency REIT was the first developmental REIT introduced in Pakistan, and Signature Residency REIT followed, the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why This REIT Is Being Offered at a 30% Discount | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-26)

fact_text: The securities regulator SECP began building the REIT framework in 2005 and introduced it in 2008, and the REIT and its parent sit under listed-company disciplines.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why This REIT Is Being Offered at a 30% Discount | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-26)

fact_text: A REIT's accountability rests on a licensed management company, a trustee, regulator oversight, audited accounts, asset valuations and a rating, which the interviewee said built investor trust.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why This REIT Is Being Offered at a 30% Discount | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-26)

fact_text: The interviewee said that documented governance has attracted higher-calibre professionals to property development, a capacity the sector lacked before.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why This REIT Is Being Offered at a 30% Discount | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-26)

fact_text: The interviewee said Pakistan's cities are short of homes, offices, malls, schools, warehouses and hospitals, which property development can help fill.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why This REIT Is Being Offered at a 30% Discount | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-26)

fact_text: The interviewee said no new hotel has been built in Karachi in the 40 years up to July 2026.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why This REIT Is Being Offered at a 30% Discount | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-26)

fact_text: The interviewee described a developer's economics as land value and construction cost set against the sale price of apartments and retail.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why This REIT Is Being Offered at a 30% Discount | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-26)

fact_text: The sponsor's REIT pipeline includes hospital, hotel and infrastructure REITs, and the interviewee argued infrastructure is better built under PPP than by government.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why This REIT Is Being Offered at a 30% Discount | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-26)

fact_text: The interviewee said REIT rental revenue rises with inflation, an upside for unitholders if prices rise faster than expected.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why This REIT Is Being Offered at a 30% Discount | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-26)

fact_text: The interviewee said fast growth lifts imports, pushing the current account into deficit, after which the currency falls and interest rates rise.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why This REIT Is Being Offered at a 30% Discount | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-26)

fact_text: The interviewee cited a 10-year Pakistan Investment Bond yield of about 12-13%, against the REIT's projected 25% return.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why This REIT Is Being Offered at a 30% Discount | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-26)

fact_text: The interviewee said bank deposits pay small savers about 5-8% a year, a return that lags the proposed REIT yield.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why This REIT Is Being Offered at a 30% Discount | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-26)
